units.source_text: 杜子春很是惊诧，抬起了垂着的眼眸。

en.t: Du Zichun was greatly startled and raised his downcast eyes.

units.source_text: 令人更加不可思议的是，老人家已经消失了。

en.t: Even more unbelievable, the old man had already vanished.

units.source_text: 周围连个鬼影都没有，只有天空中的月色比之前的更加皎洁，

en.t: There was not a soul around; only the moonlight in the sky was clearer and brighter than before,

units.source_text: 川流不息的行人脑袋顶上，有两三只着急的蝙蝠开始出没。

en.t: above the heads of the endless stream of passersby, two or three flustered bats began to appear.
